mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.15%, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (unemployment rate below 4% and declining), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the market anticipates a potential recession, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when UNRATE < 4% and declining, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when INDPRO > 95, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 450,000 units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when HOUST < 450.0, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a successful monetary tightening that stabilizes the economy without causing a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL falling) fails to produce positive returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime (industrial production recovering from a contraction), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as supply chains normalize and corporate activity resumes, leading to positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when INDPRO is recovering from a contraction, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
